name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.exists_reaches_depth_succ
summary: For n ≠ 0 one Galois step, the particular t of exists_depth_step, suffices: with D = φ^{−a}(p_a), t·D = ω'D and B = D^{−n}(V − c), t(V − c) − (V − c) = (ω'^n − 1)(V − c) + ω'^nD^n(tB − B), where tB − B ∈ hodgeFil(1) because t satisfies p_a | ts − s on S (smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField; Galois differences on the value field do not raise the filtration in general), and (ω'^n − 1)/φ^{−a}(zτ) = φ^{−a}(X) with υX ≡ p^{cost} modulo p_a. For n = 0 the p^{cost(a,0)} elements of exists_depth_step_zero average the value into the fixed field modulo t.

steps.lean:
obtain hn | rfl := ne_or_eq n 0
  · let ⟨t, ω, υ, X, hω, hg, ht, hX⟩ := exists_depth_step a hn
    use 1, ![t], -υ, fun x hx μ hμ ⟨c, e⟩ ↦ ⟨p ^ cost a n • c,
      (add_mem_cancel_right (mul_mem_hodgeFil e (phiInvToBdR_mem_hodgeFil_one_iff.2 ht))).1
      ((mul_mem_hodgeFil_iff_of_not_frobE_dvd (not_frobE_dvd_zTau a) 1).1 ?_)⟩
    have := congr((valueAt a μ $(smul_inv_smul k.zTauUnit (t • x - x)), phiInvToBdR a $hX))
    convert mul_mem_hodgeFil (x := phiInvToBdR a (-υ)) algebraMap_mem_hodgeFil_zero
      (mul_mem_hodgeFil (galMonoid_smul_mem_hodgeFil t (frobE_zpow_mem_hodgeFil a n))
      (smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField t ![1] (mul_mem (zpow_mem (phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField _)
      _) (sub_mem (valueAt_mem_valueField hμ hx) (by simp))) (neg_add_cancel n ▸
      mul_mem_hodgeFil (frobE_zpow_mem_hodgeFil _ _) e) (by simp [*]))) using 1 <;> cases
      n <;> simp [↓zTauUnit_smul, ↓valueAt_smul_sub hx.1 hμ, smul_sub, hω,
      mul_pow, ↓_root_.zpow_neg, galMonoid_smul_localFieldOf, field] at this ⊢ <;> grind
  exact ⟨_, (exists_depth_step_zero a).imp fun t b ↦
    ⟨k.zTau, fun x hx μ hμ ⟨_, e⟩ ↦ BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem _ _ fun g ↦ by
    simpa [← zTauUnit_smul, ← add_eq_of_eq_sub (valueAt_smul_sub hx.1 hμ)] using!
      smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField ⟨_, g, rfl⟩ t
      (valueAt_mem_valueField hμ hx) ((sub_mem_iff_left _ algebraMap_mem_hodgeFil_zero).1 e) (b _)⟩⟩

· let ⟨t, ω, υ, X, hω, hg, ht, hX⟩ := exists_depth_step a hn
    use 1, ![t], -υ, fun x hx μ hμ ⟨c, e⟩ ↦ ⟨p ^ cost a n • c,
      (add_mem_cancel_right (mul_mem_hodgeFil e (phiInvToBdR_mem_hodgeFil_one_iff.2 ht))).1
      ((mul_mem_hodgeFil_iff_of_not_frobE_dvd (not_frobE_dvd_zTau a) 1).1 ?_)⟩
    have := congr((valueAt a μ $(smul_inv_smul k.zTauUnit (t • x - x)), phiInvToBdR a $hX))
    convert mul_mem_hodgeFil (x := phiInvToBdR a (-υ)) algebraMap_mem_hodgeFil_zero
      (mul_mem_hodgeFil (galMonoid_smul_mem_hodgeFil t (frobE_zpow_mem_hodgeFil a n))
      (smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField t ![1] (mul_mem (zpow_mem (phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField _)
      _) (sub_mem (valueAt_mem_valueField hμ hx) (by simp))) (neg_add_cancel n ▸
      mul_mem_hodgeFil (frobE_zpow_mem_hodgeFil _ _) e) (by simp [*]))) using 1 <;> cases
      n <;> simp [↓zTauUnit_smul, ↓valueAt_smul_sub hx.1 hμ, smul_sub, hω,
      mul_pow, ↓_root_.zpow_neg, galMonoid_smul_localFieldOf, field] at this ⊢ <;> grind

steps.claim: Take g = t, ω, υ, X from exists_depth_step(a, n) (t·p_a = ωp_a, p_a | ts − s on S, p_a | υX − p^{cost(a,n)}, zτX = ω^n − 1).
steps.lean: let ⟨t, ω, υ, X, hω, hg, ht, hX⟩ := exists_depth_step a hn

steps.claim: Take m = 1, the element t, and −υ; for x, μ and c with V − c ∈ hodgeFil(n) (e), V = valueAt(L, a, μ, x), take c' = p^{cost(a,n)}·c. As (V − c)·φ^{−a}(υX − p^{cost(a,n)}) ∈ hodgeFil(n + 1) (e, and ht: p_a | υX − p^{cost}, so φ^{−a}(υX − p^{cost}) ∈ hodgeFil(1)), it suffices that the value of p^{cost}x − υ·zτ⁻¹(tx − x), minus c', plus this product, lies in hodgeFil(n + 1); and, multiplication by φ^{−a}(zτ) not changing the step (p_a ∤ zτ), that φ^{−a}(zτ) times that element does.
steps.lean:
use 1, ![t], -υ, fun x hx μ hμ ⟨c, e⟩ ↦ ⟨p ^ cost a n • c,
      (add_mem_cancel_right (mul_mem_hodgeFil e (phiInvToBdR_mem_hodgeFil_one_iff.2 ht))).1
      ((mul_mem_hodgeFil_iff_of_not_frobE_dvd (not_frobE_dvd_zTau a) 1).1 ?_)⟩

steps.claim: Record zτ·(zτ⁻¹(tx − x)) = tx − x under valueAt and φ^{−a}(zτX) = φ^{−a}(ω^n − 1).
steps.lean: have := congr((valueAt a μ $(smul_inv_smul k.zTauUnit (t • x - x)), phiInvToBdR a $hX))

steps.claim: With D = φ^{−a}(p_a) (the image under phiInvToBdR a of φ^a(E)), ω' the image of the unit ω (t·p_a = ωp_a, so t·D = ω'D) and B = D^{−n}(V − c) ∈ 𝒦_a ∩ hodgeFil(0): t fixes c ∈ K' (galMonoid_smul_localFieldOf), so t(V − c) − (V − c) = t(D^nB) − D^nB = (ω'^n − 1)(V − c) + ω'^nD^n(tB − B), and φ^{−a}(zτ)·φ^{−a}(X) = ω'^n − 1 (1.1.3); expanding in both signs of n, φ^{−a}(zτ) times the element of 1.1.2 is φ^{−a}(−υ)·t(D^n)·(tB − B), with φ^{−a}(−υ) ∈ hodgeFil(0), t(D^n) ∈ hodgeFil(n) and tB − B ∈ hodgeFil(1). The last holds by smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField for this t, whose divisibility p_a | ts − s on S (exists_depth_step) is that lemma's hypothesis; the lemma raises the step from 0 to 1 only, for such an element, not in general.

convert mul_mem_hodgeFil (x := phiInvToBdR a (-υ)) algebraMap_mem_hodgeFil_zero
      (mul_mem_hodgeFil (galMonoid_smul_mem_hodgeFil t (frobE_zpow_mem_hodgeFil a n))
      (smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField t ![1] (mul_mem (zpow_mem (phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField _)
      _) (sub_mem (valueAt_mem_valueField hμ hx) (by simp))) (neg_add_cancel n ▸
      mul_mem_hodgeFil (frobE_zpow_mem_hodgeFil _ _) e) (by simp [*]))) using 1 <;> cases
      n <;> simp [↓zTauUnit_smul, ↓valueAt_smul_sub hx.1 hμ, smul_sub, hω,
      mul_pow, ↓_root_.zpow_neg, galMonoid_smul_localFieldOf, field] at this ⊢ <;> grind

steps.claim: n = 0: take the p^{cost(a,0)} elements t_l of exists_depth_step_zero(a) and υ = zτ; then the element is Σ_l t_l·x (p^{cost(a,0)}x + Σ_l (t_lx − x)), the value V lies in hodgeFil(0) (V − c ∈ hodgeFil(0)), and the value of Σ_l t_l·x has all Galois differences in hodgeFil(1) (smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField for these specially chosen t_l, with their divisibility p_a | gΣt_l s − Σt_l s as hypothesis), so it is congruent modulo hodgeFil(1) to an element of K' (BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem).
